name: How does mobile home interior repair differ from standard stick-built home repair?

mainEntity.name: How does mobile home interior repair differ from standard stick-built home repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mobile home interior repairs differ primarily in framing dimensions and wall materials. Many manufactured homes use vinyl-covered gypsum (VOG) wall panels rather than traditional taped drywall, along with non-standard 2x2 or 2x3 interior framing. Repairing these surfaces often requires specialized fasteners, specific battens, or completely skimming and framing to install standard drywall. HH Remodeling LLC handles custom framing, drywall installation, and finish carpentry, allowing owners to choose between patching existing modular panels or upgrading entire rooms to standard residential drywall and painted trim for a more permanent finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mobile home repairs often involve thin vinyl-covered wall panels, non-standard framing, and specific trim, requiring specialized carpentry and drywall techniques.
